## Native connectors

- **Slack** — board notifications and Doc share links
- **Google Drive** — import Docs; export final PDFs
- **Zapier** — 50+ triggers for CRM Light events

## API

NovaDesk exposes a REST API under `/v1`. Rate limits:

- Starter: 60 requests/minute
- Pro: 300 requests/minute
- Business: 1,000 requests/minute

API keys are scoped per workspace. Write endpoints require an Admin role.
Webhooks deliver `deal.updated`, `task.completed`, and `doc.published` events.

# NovaDesk Overview

NovaDesk is a fictional cloud workspace suite for small teams. It bundles
shared documents, task boards, and a lightweight CRM into one subscription.

## Core modules

- **Docs** — real-time collaborative documents with version history
- **Boards** — kanban boards linked to Docs and CRM records
- **CRM Light** — contacts, deals, and simple pipelines

NovaDesk targets teams of 5–50 people who outgrew free tools but do not need
enterprise suites. The product ships as a web app with optional desktop sync.

# NovaDesk Pricing

NovaDesk offers three plans. All prices are USD per seat per month, billed annually.

| Plan | Price | Seats | Storage |
|------|-------|-------|---------|
| Starter | $12 | up to 10 | 50 GB |
| Pro | $28 | up to 50 | 500 GB |
| Business | $45 | unlimited* | 2 TB |

\*Business plan seats are billed in packs of 10 after the first 50.

## Refunds

- Starter and Pro: full refund within **14 days** of first charge if usage is under 10% of seat quota.
- Business: refunds require a written request within **7 days**; proration applies after day 7.
- Annual plans may be converted to monthly mid-term with a 10% conversion fee.

## Trials

Every plan includes a 21-day trial. No credit card is required for Starter trials.

## Data protection

- Data at rest is encrypted with AES-256.
- Data in transit uses TLS 1.2+.
- Customer data is hosted in US-East and EU-West regions; customers choose residency at signup.

## Access control

- Role-based access control (Owner, Admin, Member, Guest).
- Optional SSO via SAML for Pro and Business plans.
- Audit logs retained for 90 days (Starter/Pro) or 365 days (Business).

## Compliance posture (fictional)

NovaDesk maintains SOC 2 Type II controls for the production environment.
EU customers can execute a DPA covering GDPR Article 28 processor obligations.

## Channels

- In-app chat: available on Pro and Business (business hours, UTC)
- Email: support@novadesk.example for all plans (48-hour SLA on Starter)
- Priority phone: Business only, 24/5 coverage

## Status and incidents

Status updates are posted at status.novadesk.example. Planned maintenance
windows are announced 72 hours ahead for Business customers.

## Knowledge base

Self-serve articles cover Docs permissions, Board automation recipes, and
CRM pipeline templates. Search within the app surfaces the same articles that
power this help corpus.
